'''Ki-Da''' was a [[Voss Mystics|Voss Mystic]] living on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Voss]]. He created a ritual of cleansing that allowed both [[Voss (species)|Voss]] and the outsiders to wander in the [[Nightmare Lands]] without losing their sanity.
